_comment: v0.16 I2 (#306). Walk-in only. Biome `inn` + every sprite reused. Perimeter is walls.segments (NEVER also in `blocked`) -- a raw blocked ring in this biome renders 39 crates. `blocked` is furniture only, each cell with a decor row. Plates + bravos gate on hat_job_taken.

floor_layers._pick: #225 floor differentiation (census-FREE key). The `inn` biome default is Erin's own light tavern plank [1,21] -- shipping it here would make the Rest read as a second Wandering Inn, which is the exact `brothers_parlor` pre-#49 smell. Reuses riverfarm_longhouse's darker, rougher timber swatch off the SAME Interior_Walls_01 sheet ([12,21]/[13,21]/[12,22]/[13,22], rgb~87,64,49): same wood family, same license, footstep-wood stays honest, and the hall reads as one that has been walked on harder than Erin's. Different city from the longhouse, same board -- an acceptable reuse for a working common hall.

entities._comment: I2 TALK route surface (three exchanges, the trade never named).
entities.observe: He keeps the ledger of who is owed a table rather than who is owed money, which in this house is the more delicate book. He has not written anything down since you came in.
talk_pool: Long table's for people waiting on somebody. This one's for people who've already arrived.
Silver rank drinks free on the night they make it. Once. We've never had to say it twice.
The Reinhart carriage went up the boulevard twice last month. Both times, four adventurers in this room suddenly remembered appointments.

entities.display_name: A Gnoll with a Bad Ankle
entities.observe: Boot off, ankle up on the bench, and a bowl of something going cold while she tells the story properly rather than quickly.
talk_pool: Two seasons out of Liscor and every job north of it wanted a Gnoll who could track. None of them wanted to pay one.
Ankle's fine. Ankle's been fine for a month. The bench is the good part.
Nobody in here asks what you're carrying. That's not manners, it's arithmetic.
Half the good contracts north of Liscor have a house seal on them somewhere near the bottom. Read that far before you sign, yes?

entities.observe: A full cup, untouched, at his right hand, and his chair turned three degrees off the table so he can see both doors without turning his head.
talk_pool: I'll finish it before I go. I always do.
You get the corner or you get the door. Corner's better. Door's honest.

entities.observe: Built for a bigger room than this one, and fed like it. The chairs closest in are scorched down one side, and both of them are taken.

entities._comment: Stand-in: library_shelf is the only registered rack; the kit reads from display_name + observe, not the silhouette.
entities.observe: Bows, a cracked buckler, one very good spear. Nothing here was donated. Every piece was left behind by somebody who did not come back for it, and the house does not say which.
Elbow-polished to a shine along its whole length except one arm's width at the far end, where the shine stops dead.
Long enough for a full company and set for four. The factor walks its empty half twice while you stand there and adds nothing to it.
Names in three columns, and a fourth column with no heading. The fourth is shorter than it was last season, and the chalk on it is older than the chalk anywhere else.

entities._comment: #204 plate NEAR: hanging the hat is the signal. Gated with the FAR plate so the pair cannot bank out of order. Stand-in sprite hat_stand -- no peg rail is registered; a stand reads close and the toast carries the beat.
entities.observe: Nine pegs. Eight have hats. The third from the left is empty, and wiped clean where the others carry a season of dust.
entities.toast: You hang your hat on the third peg, brim out. Across the room a man sets his cup down and lets you see him look at you.

entities._comment: #204 plate FAR = SECOND: banks handoff_quiet ONLY via the variant (hook first); base is wrong-order cold feedback. Zero new sim code.
entities.observe: A coat over the chair back, good cloth, nobody in it. The table has two cups and one of them has been sitting there since before you arrived.
entities.toast: You set it down on a table nobody has claimed and it sits there being a package. Behind you a chair turns a quarter inch, so you pick it back up.

variants.toast: The coat is already over the chair back. You lay yours beside it, lift the wrong one on the way past, and the hearth chairs stay exactly as full as they were.

entities._comment: I2 FIGHT: INTERACT-ONLY (no trigger_radius) so it cannot spring on a pinned route. New ids only -- no shared combatant is retuned. COUNT IS LOAD-BEARING: `enemies` is a PAIR, so all three player-facing strings here say two. Drafted as 'three' and corrected -- if a third rig is ever added, these strings and the sim_combat_batch cell move together.
entities.observe: Two men at the far table who arrived together, ordered separately, and have been agreeing with each other about nothing for an hour.
entities.gate_closed_toast: Two men at the far table, talking to each other. Nothing here for you tonight.

entities._comment: #318 beat 3. ORIGINAL UNNAMED ARCHETYPE, never Ressa and never Reynold (spec section 2). `invrisil_lady_client`, not the House Factor's `city_scribe`: two scribe silhouettes in one room read as one person twice, and this rig cannot read as a traveler.
entities.display_name: A Woman Who Came in a Carriage
entities.observe: Gloves still on indoors, a chair chosen for its view of the door, and nothing at all on the table in front of her. She has been served and has not touched it.
talk_pool: The hearth is good here. I have sat in worse rooms for longer and been told they were an honour.
Nobody has asked me my business since I sat down. That is what the house is actually selling.
